race.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: COCK AND BULL has progressed on the Flat since last seen over hurdles and will take plenty of beating if transferring that form back to this sphere from a mark that appears to underestimate his true ability. Migdam is feared most after an interesting trainer switch and some help from the handicapper, while Crowsatedappletart and Demanding Gerry look best of the rest. COCK AND BULL (IRE) MIGDAM (FR) CROWSATEDAPPLETART (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Crowsatedappletart (5/1), Hidalgo Des Mottes (11/2), Allo Al Khawaneej (6/1), Mont Star (7/1), Ocean Murphy (8/1), Cock And Bull (8/1), Our Girl Ellie (10/1), Demanding Gerry (10/1), Getaway Charlie (12/1), Liberated Light (14/1), River Vale (16/1), Migdam (16/1), Ollie La Ba Ba (25/1), Coolboy Christy (25/1), Thedreamistilalive (25/1), Futurum Regem (33/1), Jay Jay Zee (33/1)
